title: Finland Arctic Adventure | Inari, Northern Lights & Santa Village
highlights: Discover Finland’s natural wonders by enjoying stunning landscapes, from serene lakes and lush forests to charming villages and unique Arctic adventures.
Witness the breathtaking Northern Lights in Rovaniemi, where the Arctic sky lights up with vibrant colors over snowy landscapes.
Experience the magic of Santa Claus Village, where you can meet Santa, cross the Arctic Circle, and soak yourself in a festive wonderland.
Explore Helsinki effortlessly with the Hop-On Hop-Off Bus Tour, offering flexible access to top attractions with panoramic views
Discover Inari’s beauty with its stunning wilderness, and rich Sami culture, offering a perfect blend of serene nature and Arctic experiences.
overview:
About the tour:
Get ready for a journey through the heart of Finland, where natural beauty and cultural wonder await. Your adventure begins with a picturesque train journey to Rovaniemi, a city nestled in the Arctic Circle. Here, you'll visit the enchanting Santa Claus Village, a magical place transporting you to a world of holiday cheer. As the sun sets, prepare for a mesmerizing Northern Lights tour, a breathtaking natural phenomenon that dances across the Arctic skies. Your senses will be heightened as you witness this celestial spectacle.
Your travels then take you to Inari, a tranquil town steeped in Sámi culture and traditions. Here, you'll delve into the unique heritage of the indigenous people of Lapland and discover the serene beauty of Lake Inari. Concluding your Finnish escapade, you'll return to Helsinki, bringing you memories of Finland's pristine landscapes and enchanting experiences. Plus, with the Helsinki Card, you'll have 24-hour access to the city's best attractions, making it an unforgettable Nordic adventure.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Helsinki | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Finland! Upon arrival at Helsinki Airport, get transferred to your hotel. Check in and spend your day at leisure. You can discover the unique Temppeliaukio Church, built into solid rock, or visit the striking Kallio Church for panoramic views from its tower. You can soak yourself in the natural beauty of Seurasaari Island, where you can wander through traditional Finnish buildings and lush landscapes. Afterward, return to your hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Rovaniemi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Post check out from the hotel, head to Helsinki train station and board the train to Rovaniemi. Upon arrival in Rovaniemi, head to the hotel on your own. Check in and spend your time at leisure. You can visit  Arktikum, a captivating museum and science center that offers fascinating exhibits on Arctic life. Or, you can wander around Lordi’s Square, a lively hub in the heart of Rovaniemi, where you can enjoy the vibrant atmosphere and browse local shops. Afterward, return to your hotel.

days.title: Trip to Santa Claus Village & Northern Lights Tour
days.desc: Today, get driven for a delightful excursion to Santa Claus Village. Experience the joy of meeting Santa Claus, and send your letters from the iconic Arctic Circle. Enjoy exploring festive shops offering unique gifts and holiday treats. Later, board your transfer on an exciting Northern Lights Adventure. With expert guides leading the way, journey through the wilderness of Rovaniemi to chase the Aurora Borealis, a stunning Arctic light show. Afterward, get transferred to your hotel.

items.title: Santa Claus Village and Arctic Circle Tour
Rovaniemi Northern Lights Tour with Guaranteed Sightings

days.title: A Day at Leisure in Rovaniemi
days.desc: Today, spend your day at leisure. You can choose to opt for a visit to Husy Farm. Or, you can visit Angry Birds Park, where you can enjoy a range of fun and interactive attractions inspired by the popular game. You can also explore the Rovaniemi Church, known for its striking modern architecture and explore Korundi House of Culture, a vibrant cultural center showcasing modern art exhibitions. Afterward, return to your hotel.

days.title: Whale Watching
days.desc: Post check out from the hotel, board your transfer to Inari. Upon arrival in Inari, check into your hotel and spend your time at leisure. You can explore Inari Icepark, where you can enjoy a range of winter activities such as ice skating, snow sculpting, and sliding on icy tracks. Or, stroll around the serene Inari Lake, a picturesque frozen expanse offering stunning views. Afterward, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: A Day at Leisure in Inari
days.desc: Today, spend your time at leisure. You can visit a reindeer farm, meet these majestic animals up close, and learn about their significance in Sami culture. You can also viist Saint Tryphon Pechenga Orthodox Church, a historic gem renowned for its intricate architecture. Or, explore Pielpajarvi Wilderness Church, an iconic wooden church nestled in the serene wilderness. Afterward, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Fly to Helsinki | Leisure Day
days.desc: Post check out from the hotel, get driven to Ivalo Airport for your flight to Helsinki (not included). Upon arrival in Helsinki, check into your hotel and spend your time at leisure. You can visit Helsinki Cathedral, an iconic symbol of the city, where you can admire its neoclassical design and stunning white facade. Or, soak yourself in Finnish art at the Ateneum, the country's premier art museum, housing an extensive collection of classical and modern works. Afterward, return to your hotel.

days.title: Helsinki Card City | Helsinki Hop-On and Hop-Off Bus Tour
days.desc: Today, explore Helsinki with ease on the Hop-On and Hop-Off Bus Tour. Visit key attractions such as Helsinki Cathedral and Kamppi Chapel with over 15 stops along the route. Opt for a 24-hour or 48-hour pass for flexibility, and enjoy panoramic city views and multilingual audio guides. Frequent departures provide easy access to museums and other sights. Afterward, return to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

items.title: Helsinki Card CITY
items.desc:
Free Entry to Top Attractions: You can go to many interesting places in Helsinki without paying. Museums, art galleries, and more are included.
 Unlimited Public Transport: Enjoy unlimited travel on the city's public transportation network, including trams, buses, and the metro.
Guided City Tours: The card often includes free guided city tours, providing you with insights into Helsinki's history, culture, and landmarks. Join fellow travellers and knowledgeable guides to explore the city's hidden gems.
 Shopping and Dining Discounts: Benefit from discounts at select shops and restaurants, allowing you to indulge in Finnish cuisine or shop for souvenirs at reduced prices.
Helsinki Card Guidebook: Receive a detailed guidebook that includes information on the included attractions, maps, and tips to help you plan your visit.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out from the hotel and get driven to Helsinki Airport. Continue your journey forward and this marks the end of your trip.
